attribution.title: Activity across temperature and pH of PET hydrolase candidates.

unit_reconciliation.interpretation: The paper reports micromoles of aromatic products per mg enzyme after 48 h. All 1570 CSV observations reproduce an inferred rounded mmol/mg aggregation from the supporting workbook, but the CSV-generating procedure and explicit CSV units are not documented in the inspected record. UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED is retained; no conversion is applied.
unit_reconciliation.paper_unit_locator: Figure 2 caption; publication-level definition, not a CSV-cell unit declaration
unit_reconciliation.workbook_storage: Inspected in memory only; not saved locally
unit_reconciliation.reconstruction_hypothesis: Mean of round(U * D / 1000, 2) over matching Activity rows. Round each source row before averaging; half-even rounding as round(x*100)/100. U is mmol/L/mg, D is mL. Numerical reproduction is not proof of the original pipeline.
unit_reconciliation.arithmetic_tolerance: math.isclose(rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12), in mmol-scale numerical values; not experimental uncertainty
unit_reconciliation.previous_1566_claim: Not reproduced as an exact reconciliation. Rounding V to two decimals before averaging gives four LCC-ICCG discrepancies, but also other discrepancies across the dataset. U-volume reconstruction resolves all four and matches all 1570. See BUILD_06_REFINEMENT_REPORT.md.
unit_reconciliation.remaining_evidence_gap: Obtain the authors' CSV-generation code or explicit cell-linked unit, rounding and benchmark-aggregation declaration. Do not replace source values or treat hypothetical scaling as an authenticated measurement conversion.
unit_reconciliation.reproduction: scripts/audit_nrel_units.py (explicit manual run with bundled Python/openpyxl; in-memory supplementary retrieval only)

validation.values: Original strings; no units inferred or activities converted

working_unit_interpretation.scope: Exact cell references in the pinned CSV; sample/pH/temperature/form worksheet linkage, not construct authentication.
working_unit_interpretation.interpretation: Owner-adopted evidence-backed working unit inference from source dimensions and reproduced cell arithmetic. CSV units/generating code are not author-authenticated. Converted CSV values need not equal unrounded workbook means. No cross-source pooling or identity proof.
